emptyState.title: No glossary yet
emptyState.description: A glossary fixes how your terms are heard and translated during a meeting — product names, acronyms, and words whose meaning depends on your field. Terms here override the platform-wide glossary. Already have a list? Import a CSV or spreadsheet instead of typing it out.

emptyTerms.titleEmpty: This glossary has no terms yet
emptyTerms.description: Add the words this workspace wants heard and translated a particular way, or import a CSV or spreadsheet you already have.

newGlossary.title: New glossary
newGlossary.description: One glossary covers one direction of translation. Add another for a second language pair.

addTerm.title: Add term
addTerm.description: Applied live, to both speech recognition and translation, for every meeting in this workspace.

import.title: Import terms
import.description: Into <glossaryName></glossaryName>. A row near the top must name the columns; <term>Term</term> and <translation>Translation</translation> are required. Field, Definition, Note, Part of speech and Priority are used when present.
import.expectedPairSame: This glossary is {source} → {target}, so the second column is what each term means rather than a translation.
import.expectedPairDifferent: This glossary is {source} → {target}. The second column should be {target}.
import.columnsFoundButEmpty: The columns were found, but every row below them was empty.
import.missingColumns: The first row must name the columns, and must include a Term column and a Translation column.
import.fileCouldNotBeRead: That file could not be read ({detail}). Save it as .xlsx or .csv and try again, or start from the sample below.
import.rowsReady: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} ready. Terms already in this glossary are skipped, and the count is reported after the import.
import.showingFirst: Showing the first 50 of {count}. All {count} will be imported.
import.sampleSkipped: The template's sample row was skipped.

toasts.imported: Imported {count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}}.
toasts.importedSkipped: Imported {count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}}, skipped {skipped} already in this glossary.
toasts.glossaryCreatedWithTerms: Glossary created with {count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}}.
toasts.glossaryTermsFailed: Glossary created, but its terms could not be added.
toasts.customizingTerm: Pre-filled term '{term}' into Custom Glossary form.
toasts.createGlossaryFirstForCustom: Create a glossary pair first to customize this term.

globalView.bannerNotice: Published terms are applied by default across meetings. Custom workspace terms take precedence on conflict. Workspace custom glossaries are strictly private and never exposed to platform admins.
globalView.searchPlaceholder: Search by term, translation, domain, context...
globalView.emptyDescription: Try searching with a different keyword or domain filter.
globalView.loadError: Could not load global glossary terms.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters
validation.targetLanguageRequired: Select the language it is translated into
validation.targetTermRequired: The translation to use is required

initialTerms.addTranslationOrClear: Add the translation, or clear the term.
initialTerms.addTermOrClear: Add the term, or clear the translation.

initialTermsField.title: First terms
initialTermsField.optionalHint: Optional — you can add more later

importTemplate.title: Import template
importTemplate.description: One file shape for every glossary. Pick the language pair you are importing; the Source and Target columns follow those languages. Fill in one term per row below the header.
importTemplate.sampleNote: The grey row is a sample. It shows the format and is skipped when the file is imported.
importTemplate.downloadFailed: Could not build the file. Try the .csv instead.
importTemplate.fallbackNotice: Showing the built-in template: the saved one could not be loaded.
importTemplate.columnsNote: Headers are matched without case and without the language in brackets, so “Translation (Japanese)” and “translation” are the same column. Files made with the old Term / Translation header still import.

pairEditor.label: Language pair
pairEditor.changeFailed: Could not change the language pair.
pairEditor.confirm: Only the label changes — the {count, plural, one {# term stays} other {# terms stay}} as written, nothing is translated. Change to {source} → {target}?

warpbot.readyDescription: WarpBot can now use the terms in "{name}".
warpbot.failedDetail: {count, plural, one {# term was not loaded} other {# terms were not loaded}}. Edit or re-import to try again.
warpbot.unconfirmedDetail: {count, plural, one {WarpBot has not confirmed # term} other {WarpBot has not confirmed # terms}}. Import again to retry.
